
SHOW-EPIC
Display details of an epic including associated work units

USAGE
  fspec show-epic <epicId>

ARGUMENTS
  <epicId> (required)
    Epic ID (e.g., user-management)

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Show epic details
  $ fspec show-epic user-management
  user-management
Title: User Management Features
Description: Handles user accounts

Work Units:
  AUTH-001 - User login feature
  AUTH-002 - Password reset

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec list-epics
  fspec create-epic
  fspec list-work-units
